summary: The PR adds `startswith` and `endswith` methods to the `Query` class in `tinydb/queries.py`, implemented via the existing `_generate_test` helper. The lambdas guard with `isinstance(value, str)` so missing fields, `None`, and numbers safely don't match without erroring. New tests in `tests/test_startswith_seed.py` cover startswith, endswith, and non-string non-matching. The full test suite passes and my own edge-case snippet confirms correct behavior.

checks.claim: startswith/endswith methods exist and match strings correctly
non-string values (None, number, missing field) do not match and raise no error
checks.evidence: python -c snippet: startswith('A') on [{name:5},{name:None},{x:1},{name:'Al'}] returned ['Al'] with no exception

checks.claim: full existing test suite still passes
